entries.label: P: “Ozren Kolaić is a Senior Unity Developer with over 8 years …”
entries.value: Ozren Kolaić is a Senior Unity Developer with over 8 years of experience. He started in 3D modeling and technical art before moving into system architecture and technical leadership. Ozren specializes in multiplayer (PVP) games, mobile platforms, and WebGL. He has strong expertise in C# and the Unity ecosystem.

entries.label: P: “His background connects both artistic and engineering sides…”
entries.value: His background connects both artistic and engineering sides of game development. He leads multidisciplinary teams, runs code reviews, and mentors developers. He believes that clean architecture and strong team communication are key to a project’s success.
